name: Montauk Project
description: The Montauk Project is a conspiracy theory alleging that secret U.S. government experiments in time travel, teleportation, mind control and contact with extraterrestrials were conducted at Camp Hero / Montauk Air Force Station on Long Island, New York; the claims, originating with Preston Nichols and Peter Moon in the early 1990s, are widely characterised as fiction.
origin: Allegedly centred at Camp Hero / Montauk Air Force Station on the eastern tip of Long Island, New York. As a conspiracy theory it has spread globally through Nichols' and Moon's books and subsequent media adaptations.
